question:
The following table presents the part of the electromagnetic spectrum and their corresponding major applications.

Part of the electromagnetic spectrum:
P. Microwave
Q. UV rays
R. Gamma rays
S. Radio wave

Applications:
I. For purifying the water
II. For warming the food
III. For AM and FM communication systems
IV. For treating the Cancer cells

The correct option is :
solution:
Microwaves are used in microwave ovens for warming food: P-II.

UV rays kill germs and are used for purifying water: Q-I.

Gamma rays are used in radiotherapy for treating cancer cells: R-IV.

Radio waves are used for AM and FM communication: S-III.

Correct matching: P-II, Q-I, R-IV, S-III.
